id.description: For internal use only! The ID (GUID) to assign to the newly created Object.

name.description: The name of the new object.

type.description: The type of the new object. See \ref wobjects_index for possible object types.

notes.description: The notes or comments of the new object.

parent.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the parent of the new object.

list.description: The name of the list in which to insert the object. If this argument is set, the object gets inserted in a list owned by the parent and not as a child.

platform.description: The ID (GUID) or unique name of the platform used when setting properties via this command. Not specifying a platform sets the value for all linked platforms.

autoAddToSourceControl.description: Determines if Wwise automatically performs an Add source control operation for affected work units. Defaults to true.

onNameConflict.description: The action to take if "parent" already has a child with the same name. Default value is "fail". See \ref waapi_create_objects_modes for more information.

oneOf.description: The new object receives a unique name, which is the name of the existing object with numbers appended.
The object at the destination is deleted (including its children), and a new object is created.
No changes are made, and an error is returned. This is the default value.
Merges the new or modified properties, references, and children into the object at the destination, and does not change any unmodified aspects of the existing object.

^@[:_a-zA-Z0-9]+$.description: Sets the value of property \@propertyName. See \ref wobjects_index for property names.

description: Creates an object of type 'type', as a child of 'parent'. See \ref waapi_import for more information about creating objects. Also see \ref ak_wwise_core_audio_import to import audio files to Wwise. To create Effect or Source plug-ins, use \ref ak_wwise_core_object_set, and see \ref wobjects_index for the classId.
